title: Stoneworks
description: This is stoneworks, a worldbuiilding and geopolitics server.
body:
# Stoneworks Minecraft
Hello and welcome to Stoneworks Minecraft! We are a server centered around world building nations, towns and history on a Minecraft Java 1.21.8 server using the Lands plugin, similar to Towny. With 6 years of history, Stoneworks is the gold standard for worldbuilding on minecraft. Not just for the roleplay nerds, Stoneworks has an intricate war system for the dedicated pvper as well. 
# 
🗺️ Dynmap: [map.stoneworks.gg](https://map.stoneworks.gg/abex1/#abexilas:0:0:0:1500:0:0:0:0:perspective)

NOTE: The listed modpack is **NOT** a REQUIREMENT to join, but is recomended.
